name: Self Help
source:
Gary's most complicated case is in his office, and they're ready for their session. Or at least, ready as they'll probably ever be. Will today be the day a breakthrough happens, or will the session just continue as usual? You decide!

[From [url=https://teharra-rose.itch.io/self-help]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
加里最复杂的案件在他的办公室里，他们已经准备好开会了。或者至少，他们可能会做好准备。今天会是突破的一天，还是会像往常一样继续进行？你决定！

[来自[url=https://teharra-rose.itch.io/self-help]Itch.io[/url]]
